images.caption: U.S. Navy Hospital Corpsman 2nd Class Corey J. Buchanan, with Task Force Koa Moana 16.2, leads instructions on general health and wellness to local youth at St. John’s College, Ovalau, Fiji, July 12, 2016. Fiji is part of Task Force Koa Moana’s deployment throughout the Asia-Pacific region where Marines and Sailors will share engineering and infantry skills with the Republic of Fiji Military Forces to strengthen mil-to-mil relationships and interoperability. (U.S. Marine Corps photo by Lance Cpl. Jesus McCloud)

Ratu Tanoa, King of Bau The image is of Ratu Tanoa Visawaqa, King of Bau 1829-1832 and 1837-1852. This is perhaps one of the earliest depictions of the rare black-lipped pearl-shell breast plates, civa. On his head is the turban-like masi head scarf, i-vauvau. Reg. Number: P 25.6 82, Fiji Museum Fiji Museum photograph
images.alt: Ratu Tanoa, King of Bau The image is of Ratu Tanoa Visawaqa, King of Bau 1829-1832 and 1837-1852.
